zu: Phakathi ehlathini, phakathi ngaphansi kwengubo — amandla afanayo ncamashi.

en: No streaming service has a genre for this.
af: Geen stroomdiens het 'n genre vir hierdie nie.
zu: Ayikho i-streaming service ene-genre yalokhu.

en: Tonight the forest is telling its stories in a whisper.
af: Die bos vertel vanaand sy stories op fluistertoon.
zu: Namuhla ebusuku ihlathi lixoxa izindaba zalo ngokuhleba.

en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.
af: Die son het ingeklok voor jou wekker eers probeer het.
zu: Ilanga lifike emsebenzini ngaphambi kokuba i-alarm yakho izame.

en: Air this clear should come with a warning: plans will be made.
af: Lug so skoon, jy kan amper tot môre toe sien.
zu: Umoya ocwebe kangaka kufanele uze nesexwayiso: kuzokwenziwa izinhlelo.

en: This is leave-form weather and HR knows it.
af: Weer soos dié vra mooi vir 'n verlofvorm.
zu: Yisimo sezulu se-leave form futhi i-HR iyakwazi.

en: 'Quick dip before work.' Nobody in history has been quick.
af: Nog 'n 'vinnige swem voor werk' — die Kaap se oudste leuen.
zu: 'Ukucwila okusheshayo ngaphambi komsebenzi.' Akekho emlandweni oke washeshisa.

en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
af: Die dag het nog niks verkeerd gedoen nie. Gee hom kans.
zu: Awekho amaphutha kusukela namuhla kuze kube manje. Kuhlanganise nezulu.

en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.
af: Hoëveld-oggend: koud genoeg vir 'n jas, mooi genoeg dat jy nie omgee nie.
zu: Amakuseni e-Highveld: ayaqanda, mahle, awukho uxolo.

en: Inbox: 47. Sky: flawless. Priorities: sorted.
af: Eerste koffie buite. Die e-posse kan wag.
zu: I-inbox: 47. Izulu: alinasici. Okubaluleke kakhulu: kulungisiwe.

en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.
af: Als dié blou, dié vroeg? Iets broei.
zu: Isimo sezulu esiziphethe kahle kangaka ngokungangabazeki senza okuthile.

en: Mornings like this are why Capetonians never stop mentioning it.
af: Oggende soos dié is hoekom Kapenaars nooit ophou spog nie.
zu: Amakuseni anjena yiwo abangela ukuthi abaseKapa bangaqedi ukukhuluma ngawo.

en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.
af: Die son vat sy tyd vanoggend, en dit wys.
zu: Ilanga lithathe isikhathi salo namuhla ekuseni. Kufanele ukulinda.

en: Signal: weak. Views: unfair. Deadlines: whose?
af: Berg-oggende laat jou vergeet wat 'n deadline is.
zu: I-signal: ibuthaka. Imibono: ayinabulungiswa. Ama-deadline: kabani?

en: One of those days the group chat will hear about for years.
af: Dis die soort dag waarvan die groepchat nog jare gaan hoor.
zu: Olunye lwalezo zinsuku i-group chat ezoluzwa iminyaka.

en: Enjoy it. There's a cold front out there doing warm-ups.
af: Geniet dit. Die koue front het klaar sy tasse gepak.
zu: Kujabulele. Kukhona amakhaza laphaya ngaphandle enza ukufudumala.

en: One perfect day issued. Non-transferable. Spend it wisely.
af: Een perfekte dag uitgereik. Moet hom nie op admin mors nie.
zu: Usuku olulodwa oluphelele lukhishiwe. Aludluliseleki. Lusebenzise ngokuhlakanipha.

en: The sun woke up and chose glorious.
af: Vandag se son het opgedaag met attitude.
zu: Ilanga livuke lakhetha ubukhazikhazi.

en: Morning people might be onto something. Don't tell them.
af: Oggendmense is dalk oor iets reg. Sê dit net vir niemand nie.
zu: Abantu bakuseni mhlawumbe kukhona abakubambile. Ungabatsheli.

en: Small-town quiet: you can actually hear yourself think. Terrifying.
af: Platteland-stilte: jy kan jou eie gedagtes hoor. Skrikwekkend.
zu: Ukuthula kwedolobhana: ungakwazi ngempela ukuzwa ucabanga. Kuyethusa.

en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.
af: Hier jaag niemand nie. Die son ook nie.
zu: Lapha ngaphandle ngisho nelanga liyenqaba ukusheshisa.

en: Even Monday looks photogenic in this light.
af: Oggendson wat só lyk maak selfs Maandag draaglik.
zu: Ngisho noMsombuluko ubukeka muhle kulokhu kukhanya.

en: Zero drama in the sky. Highly unusual. Gladly accepted.
af: Die dag begin sonder drama. Verdag, maar ons vat dit.
zu: Awukho umdlalo ezulwini. Akujwayelekile nakancane. Kwamukelwe ngenjabulo.

en: 'One hour at the beach.' History's most confident lie.
af: 'Net 'n uurtjie strand toe.' Vier uur later...
zu: 'Ihora elilodwa ebhishi.' Amanga anethemba kunawo wonke emlandweni.

en: Atlantic rule: the water is freezing and everyone lies about it.
af: Die water is yskoud en almal maak of dit lekker is. Tradisie.
zu: Umthetho we-Atlantic: amanzi ayaqanda futhi wonke umuntu uqamba amanga ngawo.

en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
af: Weer só mooi is nie gratis nie. Iewers wag 'n suidooster.
zu: Isimo sezulu esiphelele kangaka simboleko. Umoya waseningizimu ugcina amarisidi.

en: Tidal pool water: instant regret, then instant youth.
af: Getypoel-water: eers spyt, dan skielik tien jaar jonger.
zu: Amanzi echibi lolwandle: ukuzisola ngokushesha, bese kuba ubusha ngokushesha.

en: All meetings moved to the shallow end.
af: Vandag se enigste vergadering is by die vlak kant.
zu: Yonke imihlangano ithuthele ngasehlangothini elingajulile.

en: Highveld winter flex: laundry dry before the kettle's even done.
af: Hoëveld-winter: die wasgoed is droog voor die ketel kook.
zu: I-flex yasebusika ye-Highveld: iwashing yoma ngaphambi kokuba iketela liphele.

en: Clear sky, clear diary. One of those is a lie.
af: Nul wolke. Nul verskonings. Nul kans dat ek binne bly.
zu: Izulu elicwebile, idayari ecwebile. Okunye kwalokho kungamanga.

en: The weather made the plans. We just RSVP'd.
af: Die weer het die planne gemaak. Ons het net opgedaag.
zu: Isimo sezulu senze izinhlelo. Thina si-RSVP'ile nje.

en: You don't waste a sky like this on being sensible.
af: Sonskyn soos dié los jy nie vir Maandag nie.
zu: Awuchithi izulu elinjena ngokwenza izinto ezihlakaniphile.

en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.
af: Karoo-blou: presies dieselfde perfekte kleur van hier tot môre.
zu: Izulu laseKaroo: uhlaza olufanayo olungenasici amakhilomitha angu-400 alandelayo. Kuqinisekisiwe.

en: Padkos hits different under infinite sky. That's just science.
af: Padkos smaak beter onder 'n lug sonder einde.
zu: I-padkos inambitheka ngokwehlukile ngaphansi kwezulu elingapheli. Kuyisayensi nje.

en: The mountain skipped the tablecloth today. Full outfit reveal.
af: Die berg het vandag sy tafeldoek by die huis gelos. Volle mondering.
zu: Intaba iyeqe indwangu namuhla. Ukuveza kokugqoka okuphelele.

en: Days like this aren't earned. They're issued.
af: Só 'n dag koop jy nie. Jy kry hom net.
zu: Izinsuku ezinjena aziholelwa. Ziyakhishwa.

en: Cancel everything. This is THE day winter was hiding.
af: Kanselleer alles. Dis DIÉ dag.
zu: Khansela konke. YILOLU usuku ubusika obebulufihlile.

en: Off-season beach: same ocean, zero fight for parking.
af: Strand in die winter: dieselfde see, nul geveg oor parkering.
zu: Ibhishi elingekho esizinini: ulwandle olufanayo, akukho ukulwa ngendawo yokupaka.

en: 'Just one sundowner' — famous last words, every single time.
af: 'Een sundowner,' sê die mense wat die sterre gaan sien uitkom.
zu: 'I-sundowner eyodwa nje' — amagama okugcina adumile, ngaso sonke isikhathi.

en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
af: Die son gaan af soos hy weet ons kyk.
zu: Ilanga liyawudonsa lo mphumo. Eqinisweni, likufanele.

en: Nobody's leaving early under a sky like this.
af: Dié lug is die rede hoekom niemand vanaand vroeg huis toe gaan nie.
zu: Akekho ohamba kusenesikhathi ngaphansi kwezulu elinjena.

en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.
af: As die weer só gedra, gedra ons ook. Min of meer.
zu: Uma isimo sezulu siziphatha kahle kangaka, nathi siyaziphatha. Cishe.

en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
af: Check jy die weer, of check jy of Saterdag se braai aan is? Presies.
zu: Yiba neqiniso — uvule le-app ukuqinisekisa i-braai yangoMgqibelo.

en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.
af: Die dag was so mooi, selfs die verkeer het saamgespeel.
zu: Usuku oluhle kangangokuthi ngisho ne-rush hour ibizwakala njengokukhetha.

en: Highveld golden hour: costs nothing, upstages everything.
af: Goue uur op die Hoëveld: gratis, en steeds onbetaalbaar.
zu: I-golden hour ye-Highveld: ayibizi lutho, idlula konke.

en: Golden hour runs daily. Attendance still somehow optional.
af: Goue uur: elke dag gratis, en ons is elke dag weer verbaas.
zu: I-golden hour iyenzeka nsuku zonke. Ukuza kwayo kusengokukhetha.

en: The evening showed up in its Sunday best.
af: Die aand het opgedaag met sy Sondagklere aan.
zu: Kusihlwa kufike kugqoke okokugqoka kwangeSonto.

en: Verandah weather. The couch will understand.
af: Stoepsit-weer. Die TV kan maar wag.
zu: Isimo sezulu se-stoep. Isofa lizoqonda.

en: Best seat in the house isn't in the house.
af: Die beste sitplek in die huis is buite.
zu: Isihlalo esihle kunazo zonke endlini asikho endlini.

en: Last swim of the day always feels like a secret.
af: Laaste swem van die dag voel altyd soos 'n geheim.
zu: Ukubhukuda kokugcina kosuku kuhlala kuzwakala njengemfihlo.

en: Suspiciously calm out there. We'll allow it.
af: Weer só rustig maak 'n mens agterdogtig én dankbaar.
zu: Kuthule ngokusolisayo laphaya. Sizokuvumela.

en: House rules: last over when the streetlights win.
af: Die reëls is eenvoudig: laaste boulbeurt wanneer die straatligte aankom.
zu: Imithetho yasendlini: i-over yokugcina uma izibani zomgwaqo ziwina.

en: Small town, giant sky, zero rush.
af: Klein dorpie, groot lug, geen haas nie.
zu: Idolobhana elincane, izulu elikhulu, akukho ukujaha.

en: Every so often Cape Town explains itself. No notes.
af: Die Kaap wys af en toe presies hoekom almal so aangaan oor hom.
zu: Ngezinye izikhathi iKapa iyazichaza. Awekho amanothi.

en: Dinner tastes better when the walk there looks like this.
af: Aandete smaak beter as die pad soontoe só lyk.
zu: Isidlo sakusihlwa sinambitheka kangcono uma uhambo oluya khona lubukeka kanjena.

en: Someone turned the stars up to full volume.
af: Iemand het die sterre se volume opgedraai.
zu: Umuntu unyuse izinkanyezi zaya ku-volume egcwele.

en: Coals fading, stories only warming up.
af: Die kole is amper dood. Die stories kom nou eers by.
zu: Amalahle ayacima, izindaba zisaqala ukushisa.

en: City folk pay good money for this ceiling.
af: Stadsmense betaal groot geld hiervoor. Hier's dit sommer verniet.
zu: Abantu basedolobheni bakhokha imali enkulu ngalolu phahla.

en: Sky this clear means tomorrow's a scorcher. Stay a while.
af: Lug só helder beteken môre skroei. Sit gerus nog 'n rukkie.
zu: Izulu elicwebe kangaka lisho ukuthi kusasa kuzoshisa. Hlala isikhashana.

en: Nobody's called it a night. The night agrees.
af: Niemand het 'huis toe' gesê nie. Niemand gaan ook nie.
zu: Akekho othe sekuphelile. Ubusuku buyavuma.

en: Clear, in theory. The Cape Doctor doesn't always RSVP.
af: Helder, in teorie. Die Kaapse Dokter RSVP nie altyd nie.
zu: Kucwebile, ngokombono. UDokotela waseKapa akahlali e-RSVP'a.
